CustomField.label: If Query Finds No Records
CustomField.description: What the check should do when the Primary Query (SOQL) finds no records. If left blank, the check is marked Skipped. Required when How To Interpret Query Results is At least one record must pass, Every record must pass, or Compare query results as lists.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose what no records means for this check. Example: a query for open high-priority cases finding no records usually means the record is healthy, so choose Pass the check. Blank defaults to Skip the check.
